title: The Arusha Declaration says Tanzania had chosen money as the wrong weapon
summary: The 1967 Arusha Declaration says the earlier choice of money as the weapon was the wrong one.
body: The Arusha Declaration of 5 February 1967 says that in the past the wrong weapon was chosen, because money was chosen as the weapon. The declaration is Tanzania's policy text on self-reliance. It is a party's program, not a measured account of the economy. The wording on the page includes: "is obvious that in the past we have chosen the wrong weapon for our struggle, because we chose money as our weapon. We arc trying to overcome our economic weakness by using the weapons of the economically strong - weapons which in fact we do not possess. By our thoughts, words, and actions it appears as if we have come to the conclusion that without money we cannot". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
